productContexts.label: only QDs reference
notes: The QD-only reference matches the total added QD amount, including QDs free in unwashed hybrids.

productContexts.label: Figure 2a: Ag/SiO2 shell 7 ± 1 nm
notes: 50 µL of 1 M TEOS is the source-ordered dose for this branch.
Figure 2 TEM measures core-shell precursor before QD adsorption.

productContexts.label: Ag/SiO2-QD unwashed dispersion from 7 nm shell
notes: Parent Figure 2 shell thickness 7 ± 1 nm; not remeasured on QD-attached final objects.
Figure 3 fluorescence relative to free-QD reference is decreased.
The complex was not collected/washed to remove excess QDs; this is an optical dispersion, not purified isolated hybrid.
The authors reason that free unadsorbed QDs cannot interact optically with Ag/SiO2, while the QD-only reference matches the total QD dose.

general_background.title: Building a gel network
